segmentation.selection: Training features only; discard candidates with a cluster below 2% of training rows when possible. Choose the smallest k within 0.01 of best eligible training silhouette. Inspect training inertia as an elbow diagnostic; it never uses churn.
segmentation.encoding: Eight numeric/ordinal inputs median-imputed and standardised. Complains and Tariff Plan mode-imputed and full one-hot encoded without extra scaling; a category mismatch contributes squared distance 2. Ordinal band steps are treated equally. The geometry is a modelling assumption, not business value or risk.

rubric_note: Three supervised classifiers plus one unsupervised clustering model. Instructor approval may be needed if four supervised classifiers or four state-of-the-art models are required; full rubric compliance is not claimed.
pr_auc_definition: Average precision: sum of recall increments weighted by precision; not trapezoidal integration.
selection: Maximum validation churn F1; validation ROC-AUC breaks ties. Fixed threshold 0.5. Decision Tree: 12 validation-only configurations.
